Lower Text: [Security] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow or red card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
Upper Text: While you don't have [Heat Training] in the battle area, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow or red card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
